scope: Desktop production adapter, inventory notifications and real consumable listener; provider cache, timers and frames mocked. No native client available. Tests use five client-flag models, not native certification. Excluded callbacks are not invoked.
scenario: 25 kind/client combinations; acquisition, depletion, count-only control, full and incremental snapshots, 200-callback bursts, other-character exclusion and no batch metadata leak
profiler: off; subprocess wall time includes harness overhead; not addon CPU/FPS/native latency
warmup: none; fresh Lua process each run
trials: five alternating matched process pairs; deterministic 400 assertions each
